T: Get to Mars. Then get to dinner.
D: A construction worker discovers he might be a secret agent from Mars.
P: Serve dinner when Quaid finally gets to Mars and walks into Venusville.
S: Thin fried potato chips dusted with vinegar powder and sweet paprika
Potatoes sliced thin on a mandoline, fried at 170C, tossed in vinegar powder, salt and paprika for a red Mars dust.
Last Resort red salsa loaded nachos

Corn chips layered with spiced black beans, cheddar and jalapeños, baked until melted, then piled with smoky red salsa, sour cream and coriander. Heat the oven to 200C. Warm a drained 400g tin black beans with 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp smoked paprika, lightly crushing them. Layer 250g corn chips on a tray with the beans, 200g grated cheddar and sliced jalapeños in two layers. Bake 8 minutes until melted. Blitz 3 roasted tomatoes, 1 chipotle in adobo, half an onion, lime and salt for salsa. Top the nachos with salsa, sour cream and coriander.
Roasted red peppers blended with walnuts and pomegranate molasses, flatbread
Roast red capsicums until black, peel, blitz with toasted walnuts, pomegranate molasses, garlic, cumin and chilli (muhammara). Warm flatbread.
M: Venusville smoky red beans and rice
the cheap eats in the Mars mining quarter

Red kidney beans simmered with smoked sausage, onion, celery, capsicum and Cajun spice until creamy, over fluffy white rice with spring onion and hot sauce. Brown 300g sliced smoked sausage in a heavy pot. Add 1 diced onion, 2 celery sticks and 1 green capsicum and cook 8 minutes. Stir in 3 garlic cloves, 2 tsp Cajun seasoning and 2 bay leaves. Add 2 drained 400g tins kidney beans and 600ml chicken stock and simmer 40 minutes, mashing some beans to thicken. Cook 300g long grain rice. Serve the beans over rice with sliced spring onion and hot sauce.
Red lentils, red peppers and smoked paprika, with Greek yogurt on top
Red lentil and capsicum stew with onion, garlic, smoked paprika, tomato and stock, simmered 25 minutes, yoghurt on top.
W: Meringue with whipped cream, fresh raspberries and raspberry sauce

Crisp-shelled marshmallowy pavlova piled with whipped cream, fresh raspberries and a glossy red berry sauce, finished with mint. Heat the oven to 150C. Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp white vinegar. Spread into a 20cm round on baking paper, drop to 120C and bake 75 minutes, then cool in the oven. Simmer 150g frozen raspberries with 2 tbsp sugar for 5 minutes and cool. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 250g raspberries, the sauce and mint.
K: Vodka, blood orange juice and orange liqueur shaken and strained

Vodka shaken with fresh blood orange, orange liqueur and lime until ice cold, strained into chilled coupes the colour of Martian dust. Chill 4 coupes. Squeeze 3 blood oranges to get about 160ml juice. Shake 160ml vodka, the blood orange juice, 40ml orange liqueur and 20ml lime juice with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into the coupes and garnish each with a thin blood orange wheel. If blood oranges are out of season, use orange juice and a splash of grenadine.

m.note: Red lentils, red peppers and smoked paprika, with Greek yogurt on top
m.how: Soften 1 onion, 2 garlic cloves and 2 diced red capsicums. Add 1 tsp smoked paprika, 250g red lentils, 1 tin crushed tomatoes and 750ml stock and simmer 25 minutes until thick. Serve in bowls with a spoon of Greek yoghurt on top.
